title: A notifier that outgrows its send-once world

initial_repo.README.md:
# notify

Notification sender. See git history for the design conversation.

stages.message: notify.py: a Notifier that takes a sender callable — we plug in whatever actually delivers the message — and notify(user, message) calls sender(user, message). That's really it. Tests.

requirements.text: Notifier(sender) with notify(user, message) calling the sender

stages.message: We moved onto a queue that redelivers messages when handlers are slow, so notify may get called twice for the same delivery. Each delivery comes with an id: notify(user, message, delivery_id=...). If we've already seen that id, skip the send. Calls with no id are still fine and always send. It'd also be handy if notify tells us whether it actually sent (True) or skipped (False).

requirements.text: notify(user, message, delivery_id) sends at most once per delivery_id; returns True if sent, False if a redelivery was skipped

hidden_tests.test_stage2_dedup.py:
from notify import Notifier


def test_same_delivery_id_is_sent_once():
    sent = []
    n = Notifier(lambda u, m: sent.append((u, m)))
    assert n.notify("alice", "hi", delivery_id="d1") is True
    assert n.notify("alice", "hi", delivery_id="d1") is False  # redelivery
    assert sent == [("alice", "hi")]
    assert n.notify("alice", "hi", delivery_id="d2") is True  # a new delivery
    assert len(sent) == 2


def test_without_delivery_id_it_always_sends():
    sent = []
    n = Notifier(lambda u, m: sent.append((u, m)))
    n.notify("bob", "hello")
    n.notify("bob", "hello")
    assert len(sent) == 2

stages.message: The SMTP gateway flakes now and then. Retry a failed send up to 2 times. But careful: a send that already went out must never repeat for the same delivery id, and a delivery that keeps failing should raise the last error and shouldn't be remembered as done — the queue will redeliver it later and it should go out then. Everything else — the dedup rule and the True/False return — still means the same as before.

requirements.text: failed sends are retried up to 2 times; only a successful send marks a delivery_id as done

hidden_tests.test_stage3_retry.py:
import pytest

from notify import Notifier


class FlakySender:
    def __init__(self, fail_first):
        self.calls = 0
        self._fail_first = fail_first

    def __call__(self, user, message):
        self.calls += 1
        if self.calls <= self._fail_first:
            raise RuntimeError("smtp down")


def test_retry_then_success_is_remembered():
    s = FlakySender(1)
    n = Notifier(s)
    assert n.notify("a", "m", delivery_id="x") is True
    assert s.calls == 2  # one failure, one retry that worked
    assert n.notify("a", "m", delivery_id="x") is False
    assert s.calls == 2  # it already went out: never again


def test_failed_delivery_is_not_marked_done():
    s = FlakySender(3)  # more failures than retries
    n = Notifier(s)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        n.notify("a", "m", delivery_id="y")
    assert s.calls == 3  # one try plus two retries, then give up
    assert n.notify("a", "m", delivery_id="y") is True  # not remembered
    assert s.calls == 4
    assert n.notify("a", "m", delivery_id="y") is False
    assert s.calls == 4
